scientific_question: Can a genuinely compact expert c_fc feature map, built from learned spectral diagonals between fixed global orthogonal FHT mixers, reproduce the terminal dense-expert function while c_proj remains the evidence-required dense residual-write exception?

composition_result.finding: Mapped QK plus dense complete experts passes at 5TPP by -0.0443222523 CE versus the matched dense-MoE control, but neither expert matrix is compressed.

directed_product_result.finding: Compositional task-selected c_fc direction matters, but the deployed mechanism is an update chart around a materialized dense c_fc rather than a compact weight or function representation.

temporal_state_result.finding: Retrofitting the accepted directed-product family to dense Muon state remains far below the frozen recovery gates even after the code exceeds dense-state byte storage. A new c_fc candidate must therefore be born and optimized in compact coordinates.

causal_reconciliation.write_map_boundary: Attention V/O and expert c_proj remain dense full-state exceptions. Existing same-gauge functional and unrestricted shared-gauge oracles reject the tested compact residual-write families; this test changes only c_fc.
causal_reconciliation.not_a_lora_basis: No learned dense basis, low-rank residual, or materialized dense c_fc is permitted. Fixed signs and normalized FHTs define the orthogonal mixers; only diagonal spectral coordinates and an output bias are learned.

source.terminal_gauge: Collect MLP inputs with the complete terminal model. Use its terminal router, terminal expert c_fc targets, and terminal dense expert c_proj on both target and candidate sides.

candidate.optimizer_state_rule: A later implementation, if authorized, must create optimizer state only for s1, s2, and b; dense c_fc weights or dense c_fc optimizer state are forbidden.

control.name: fixed_orthogonal_bias_scale
control.formula: Use the identical fixed D0/H/D1/H/D2/H path with s1=s2=0; fit only one scalar scale and one hidden bias per expert.
control.purpose: Separate learned spectral direction matching from a fixed pseudo-random orthogonal feature map plus trivial calibration.

data_protocol.sampling: For each layer and bank, route terminal activations, require at least 128 assignments for every expert, and deterministically subsample 128 inputs per expert with a bank/layer/expert-derived seed.
data_protocol.anti_leakage: Fit discovery A and B independently. Heldout activations never affect signs, coordinates, optimizer stopping, thresholds, or sample selection.

fit_protocol.objective: Equal-expert mean of normalized dense-c_proj residual-output MSE plus 0.25 times normalized pre-GELU MSE.
fit_protocol.selection: Use the final registered optimizer step; no heldout checkpoint selection.

secondary: heldout action cosine between independently fitted discovery banks

decision_rule.pass: Passing every frozen gate in both independent banks authorizes only production implementation, correctness/exact-resume tests, and a separately preregistered initialization-fit shadow check. It does not directly authorize training.
decision_rule.occupancy_fail: If the terminal router cannot supply 128 examples for every expert in 131072 tokens, classify the expert atlas as insufficiently identified at 0.5TPP and do not train a generated expert.
decision_rule.representability_fail: Reject this two-spectral-diagonal fixed-orthogonal c_fc family. Do not sweep signs, depth, width, learning rate, or thresholds without a new measured residual decomposition.
decision_rule.systems: Expected under five minutes and foreground-polled. If observed runtime reaches five minutes, stop foreground polling, install a terminal-or-error watchdog with an explicit @Codex continuation prompt, and preserve the partial output.
